wikikgreviewedgraph-intro: Each page checks up to 50 snapshots. Only approved claims with readable sources still at their cited revisions appear here. Other claims may be on later pages. Approval does not establish scientific correctness.
wikikgreviewedgraph-empty: No eligible approved claims appear on this page of stored snapshots.
wikikgreviewedgraph-load-error: The reviewed graph could not be loaded. Try again later.
wikikgreviewedgraph-invalid-offset: This graph page is not available.
wikikgreviewedgraph-page-limit: More snapshots exist, but the page limit prevents loading them here.
wikikgreviewedgraph-edge-hint: Select an edge to see its supporting claims. The graph and claim list may show only part of the reviewed evidence.
wikikgreviewedgraph-edge-select: Select an edge with supporting claims to see them here.
wikikgreviewedgraph-edge-no-support: No supporting claim appears on this page. This does not show that none exists elsewhere.
wikikgreviewedgraph-edge-partial-support: Only some supporting claims appear on this page. Other claims may be elsewhere.
wikikgquestions-unavailable: The synthetic question demo is unavailable in this wiki environment.
wikikgquestions-blocked: Current evidence could not be authorized. No evidence is shown.
wikikgquestions-complete: The reviewed graph answered this question within the available evidence.
wikikgquestions-incomplete: The result is incomplete or restricted. Read the limits before drawing a conclusion.
wikikgquestions-reason-invalid_request: The question or reviewed export is invalid.
wikikgquestions-reason-unresolved_identi: The requested crop or entity could not be identified unambiguously.
wikikgquestions-reason-unresolved_parent: The requested parent relationship could not be established.
wikikgquestions-reason-relationship_miss: A required reviewed relationship is missing.
wikikgquestions-reason-property_missing: No reviewed property supports this filter.
wikikgquestions-reason-scope_unknown: The evidence does not establish the requested scope.
wikikgquestions-reason-scalar_alternativ: The reviewed claims contain incompatible values.
wikikgquestions-reason-numeric_uncertain: The reported range crosses the requested threshold.
wikikgquestions-reason-numeric_unsupport: The value or unit cannot be compared safely.
wikikgquestions-reason-numeric_not_satis: The reviewed values do not meet the requested comparison.
wikikgquestions-reason-partial_manifest: The reviewed export does not contain its full declared claim set.
wikikgquestions-reason-limits: A safety limit prevented a complete result.
wikikgquestions-reason-empty_result: No matching claim appears in this export. This is not a global negative.
wikikgquestions-reason-authorization_fai: Current evidence could not be authorized.
wikikgquestions-reason-graph_unavailable: The connected graph could not be checked.
wikikgquestions-reason-graph_corrupt: The connected graph generation is incomplete or inconsistent.
wikikgquestions-reason-graph_generation_: The active graph generation changed during this question.
wikikgquestions-reason-graph_timeout: The graph check exceeded its time limit.
wikikgquestions-reason-graph_limit: The graph data exceeds a safety limit.
wikikgextractor-desc: Discovers and extracts crop variety pages from broad pages in the current MediaWiki installation.
wikikgextractor-permissiondenied: You do not have permission to run this extractor.
